decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank window or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southern or northern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The height of the extension at the northern side boundary should be no more than 2.1m above the existing ground level, as shown on the plans hereby approved. The height shown on the plans shall be achieved through a lowering of the existing ground level by 0.37m.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Fridays and 08.30 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Details of protection measures to be provided to protect the roots of the Magnolia tree within the rear garden of the adjacent property, from equipment, machinery and the development, shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing, prior to the commencement of the work.
Condition : 8 - The window formed in the first floor rear wall shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey side/rear extension and a first floor rear extension to the house
